hooks.command: command -v graphify >/dev/null && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1; true

[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/graphify-out/graph.json" ] && echo 'Codebase questions: answer from the knowledge graph, not memory. Run graphify query "<question>" (or graphify explain / graphify path) before reading or grepping source.'; true
command -v graphify >/dev/null && graphify hook-guard search; true
command -v graphify >/dev/null && graphify hook-guard read; true
command -v graphify >/dev/null && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1; true
